```yaml name: Harness Drift Report on: schedule: - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight UTC workflow_dispatch: jobs: drift-check: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v2 with: node-version: '14' - name: Install dependencies run: npm install - name: Run repo drift check run: npm run drift-check - name: Upload artifact if there are any drifts uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2 if: failure() with: name: drift-report path: reports/drift-report.html report-generation: needs: drift-check runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Download drift report artifact uses: actions/download-artifact@v2 with: name: drift-report - name: Generate HTML report run: | echo "Harness Drift Report" echo "

Drift Report

" cat reports/drift-report.html | sed 's|" > reports/index.html - name: Commit and push report run: | git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions" git config --global user.email "actions@github.com" git checkout -b harness-drift-report git add reports/ git commit -m "Update Harness Drift Report" git push origin harness-drift-report ```
